title: 第十三章 史家祖宅第十四章 小偷
content_zh:
铁蛋跟那家丁往里走，被周围箭士盯着，过了十几重高墙箭垛，穿了三四道矮巷偏门，这才进得偏院，于是眼前忽然柳暗花明，豁然开朗。
虽城外正值大寒时节，万物蛰藏，阳下入地，阴气混凝，无风自寒，然而院墙之中，却竟暖气融融，和风旬日，满眼望去，只见佳木葱荣，奇花烂漫，一带清流，从花木深处泻于石隙之下。
再进数步，平坦宽豁，里面数楹茅屋，外面桑榆槿柘，树稚新条，仿佛立作俩列青墙。其中分畦列亩，佳蔬菜花，应当便是家丁下仆们的住处。
再往里远眺，又见红砖翠瓦所建内墙一带，红墙碧树，青溪泻玉，白石为栏，宛如火龙出水一般，环抱廊亭，远远望去，隐约可见那墙内尚还有飞楼插空，雕甍绣槛，不知多少楼阁亭台，皆隐于山坳树杪之间，大致那边就是这史家内宅，女眷所居的内院了。
朔方那种苦寒的边镇，还真没这样大户的人家，处处都是庄丁护院，道道关门皆有家兵把守，个个都是打熬炼体的武修，连铁蛋瞧着也有些头皮发麻了。
倒不是他惧了这龙潭虎穴，实在是他不认得路了。
说来惭愧，但铁蛋又不是真的狗，或者说还没炼成真的人犬呢，可没长狗鼻子。以前指挥犬群时，其实也是靠猎犬寻踪带路的，而大草原上一马平川，一望无际，车轴马道也很清晰。刚才在梁州城里头，他也只管朝最大最高的宅门过来便是了。
但一进来这门阀的高墙大院里，曲径幽巷，宅门院邸连成一片，视界被宫墙阻隔，扑鼻尽是花香和人气，拐来拐去的都是假山花木，根本分不清南北东西。更何况还全神贯注，数着周围的侍从守卫，猛然间一回头，竟记不清是走哪里进来的了……
嗯？这个味是……
带路的家丁也戒备铁蛋呢，听到身后脚步一慢下来立刻警觉，不过回头顺着他的视线，也知道对方在盯着什么了。
原来那边外院，家丁下人们的住处，正有几个人在耕田，毕竟这么大的宅邸，这么好的田，种点仙蔬灵植，瓜果蔬菜也可以自用么。
不过此时正被种下去的，却不是什么瓜果蔬菜，而是鲜血淋漓的骨头。
人骨头。
虽然血肉模糊，皮肉被剃了一干二净，但那种尺寸结构和气味，铁蛋又怎么会认不得呢。
几个家丁用板车，把已经肢解的人的残骸从内院的红墙运出来，内脏大概已经被挖了喂狗了，血肉就一铲一铲，抛到田埂里作肥，那些收拾干净，剃去了血肉的骨头，就丢进一个埋在地下，朝天开口的大铜釜里。
那东西臭气熏天，腥味十足，看着像是个粪缸，但铁蛋却能感觉到，那应该是个鼎。
就是熬丹炼药铸剑的鼎，拿来炼人也未尝不可，毕竟人乃万灵之长，本就是最上等的丹材，此时骨血被抛入鼎中熬炼，便化作泉泉灵炁，灌注天地，蒸腾的灵力又顺着地脉灵泉，游走府内，将城外的寒气都吹散开，把整个门阀大院，都烘得暖融融的，四季如春。
家丁看看这‘衙役’，随口解释道，
“那些都是家养的私奴，犯了家规，自家处置了，不碍着官府的事吧。”
铁蛋点点头，也不再多看了。

卖身为奴的，都是人家的私产，确实轮不着官府来管。
说到底，朔方的逃奴喂狗，梁州的私婢养花，贱民的骨血只是世族盘中的酒肉，魔宫的天下，大抵就是如此般光景了。
“你在这洗洗，我去请管事。”
那家丁倒也不担心，直接把铁蛋带来仆役们的住处，毕竟偏院里这么多人看着呢，若还能被这小子翻了天，史家也不必在梁州城里混了。
带路的家丁虽然一时离去，铁蛋却知道，自进得这偏院中，至少也有四五个明处的侍卫，正守着门口盯着他。
而校尉什么的也是他随口编的，真若等那家丁再把管事的带来，两边一合计必然露陷。
既然装不下去了，那便干脆一路杀进去……
“走水啦！走水啦！”
“怎么回事！”
“内院走水了！”
铁蛋也擦干净脸上的泥，蹿出去探头一瞧，果然见内院红墙那面，腾起一道烟柱，直冲云霄，隐约可见火龙缭绕，在夜色下格外显眼，火势还不小咧。
这种时节，可不像是容易起火的时候，何况这种大户人家竟能没个防备么？看来是师兄在暗中相助……
家里出了事，庄丁们自然纷纷前去救火，但那偏院里的守卫居然还专为铁蛋留下一个，摆明了是专门盯防他的，看来这世族的家教实也严谨呢。
于是铁蛋二话不说，故技重施，忽然把手里水盆朝看守卫士一泼，然后扭头就跑！陡然加速，一阵助跑起跳，翻墙跃溪！直往那边红墙拦着的内院冲去！一把翻过院墙去了！
content_en:
Tiedan and the servant walked in and were stared at by the archers around them. After passing more than a dozen layers of high wall arrow stacks and passing through three or four side gates in the low alleys, they entered the side courtyard. Suddenly, the vision suddenly became bright and clear.
Although it is the cold season outside the city, everything is hibernating, the sun is sinking into the ground, the yin energy is condensed, and there is no wind. However, inside the courtyard wall, there is a warm air, and the breeze is gentle for ten days. Looking around, I can see beautiful trees, lush flowers, and a clear stream flowing from the depths of the flowers and trees under the stone gaps.
A few steps further, it is flat and wide, with a few thatched cottages inside, mulberry, elm, hibiscus trees outside, and young and new trees, as if they were standing in two rows of green walls. Among them, there are acres of land, beautiful vegetables and flowers, which should be the residence of the servants.
Looking further in, you can see the inner wall built with red bricks and green tiles, with red walls, green trees, green streams flowing with jade, and white stone railings, like fire dragons emerging from the water, surrounding the corridors and pavilions. Looking from a distance, you can vaguely see that there are flying towers inserted in the wall, carved embroidered sills, and countless pavilions and pavilions, all hidden among the trees on the mountain. Over there is the inner courtyard of the historian's house, where the female family members live.
In a bitter and cold border town like Shuofang, there really are no such large families. There are villagers and guards everywhere, and every door is guarded by soldiers. Everyone is a martial artist who exercises, and even Tiedan feels a little numb just looking at it.
It's not that he's afraid of this dragon's pond and tiger's den, it's just that he doesn't know the way.
I'm ashamed to say it, but Tiedan isn't a real dog, or it hasn't become a real human dog yet, and it doesn't have a dog nose. In the past, when commanding a group of dogs, they actually relied on hounds to track and lead the way. However, the prairie is an endless stretch of plains, and the carriage and horse paths are also very clear. Just now in Liangzhou City, he just walked towards the largest and highest gate.
But as soon as you enter this high-walled courtyard, you will find winding alleys, gates and courtyards, and the view is blocked by the palace wall. Your nose is filled with the fragrance of flowers and popularity, and all the flowers and trees are walking around. It is impossible to distinguish north from south and east from east. What's more, he was concentrating on counting the attendants and guards around him. Suddenly he turned around and couldn't remember where he came in...
Huh? This taste is...
The servant leading the way was also wary of Tiedan. He immediately became alert when he heard the footsteps behind him slow down, but when he turned around and followed his line of sight, he knew what the other person was staring at.
It turns out that in the outer courtyard over there, where the servants live, there are a few people plowing the fields. After all, such a big mansion and such a good field, can you grow some fairy plants, fruits and vegetables for your own use?
However, what was being planted at this time was not fruits and vegetables, but bones dripping with blood.
Human bones.
Although the flesh and blood were blurred and the flesh had been shaved clean, how could Tiedan not recognize the size, structure and smell.
Several servants used carts to transport the dismembered human remains from the red wall of the inner courtyard. The internal organs had probably been dug out and fed to the dogs. The flesh and blood were shoveled into the field for fertilizer. The bones that had been cleaned and shaved of flesh and blood were thrown into a large copper cauldron buried underground with an opening toward the sky.
The thing was stinky and full of fishy smell. It looked like a dung vat, but Tiedan could feel that it should be a cauldron.
It is a cauldron used to boil elixirs and make swords, and it is not a bad idea to use it to refine people. After all, humans are the leader of all spirits, and they are the best elixir materials. At this time, the bones and blood are thrown into the cauldron to be refined, and they turn into springs and spiritual energy, which perfuse the heaven and earth.
The servant looked at the 'yamen servant' and explained casually,
"Those are all private slaves raised by the family. If they break the family rules, they will be dealt with by themselves. They will not interfere with the government's affairs."
Tiedan nodded and looked no further.
Those who sell themselves into slavery are their private property, and it is really not the government’s turn to take care of them.
After all, the escaped slaves in Shuofang feed the dogs, the maids in Liangzhou raise flowers, and the bones and blood of the untouchables are just meat and wine on the plates of the aristocracy.The world in the Demon Palace is probably like this.
"You wash up here, and I'll go ask the steward."
The servant was not worried at all and brought Tiedan directly to the servants' residence. After all, there were so many people watching in the side courtyard. If he could still be overturned by this kid, the Shi family would not have to hang out in Liangzhou City anymore.
Although the servant who led the way left temporarily, Tiedan knew that since he entered the side courtyard, there were at least four or five guards in the open, guarding the door and staring at him.
He also made up the captaincy and other things casually. If he really waited for the servant to bring the steward, the conspiracy between the two parties would be exposed.
Since I can't pretend anymore, I might as well fight all the way in...
"The water has escaped! The water has escaped!"
"What's going on!"
"The inner courtyard is flooded!"
Tiedan also wiped the mud off his face, jumped out and took a look, and sure enough, he saw a column of smoke rising from the red wall in the inner courtyard, shooting straight into the sky, and a faint fire dragon could be seen, which was particularly conspicuous in the night. The fire was not small.
This kind of season is not like a time when fires are easy to break out, let alone how can such a wealthy family be so unprepared? It seems that the senior brother is secretly helping...
When something happened at home, the villagers naturally went to put out the fire, but the guard in the side yard actually left a guard just for Tiedan, clearly to keep an eye on him. It seemed that this family's family education was really strict.
So Tiedan didn't say anything, repeated his old trick, and suddenly poured the water basin in his hand at the guard, then turned around and ran away! Accelerate suddenly, take off for a run-up, climb over the wall and jump into the stream! Go straight to the inner courtyard blocked by the red wall over there! He climbed over the courtyard wall!
